name: @cloudsforge/faucet
description: The testnet EMBER faucet. Rate limits enforced by the database rather than by a per-replica Map, dispensing driven by a chain-keyed lease so two replicas cannot double-spend one nonce, the signature committed before it is broadcast so a lost broadcast response cannot send twice, and the funding key held by micro-custody rather than by this process. Supersedes the frozen stack/repos/hearth/tools/faucet, whose limiter is in-memory, whose sender is a single in-process promise chain, and whose default chain id is EMBER MAINNET.

scripts._test: --test-concurrency=1 is required, not a preference: every database test file truncates this service's tables between cases, and node:test runs FILES in parallel by default. A TRUNCATE takes an AccessExclusiveLock, so one file's reset deadlocks against another file's inserts (40P01). Cases within a file already run in order.

_localDependencies: Every sibling takes 'link:', not 'file:'. A 'file:' path PACKS the dependency, and each of
these packages declares files: ['dist'] with a publishConfig that points main/types at dist/.
Packing therefore installs a package whose exports resolve to a dist/ that has not been built,
while its 'main' in the working tree still says src/index.ts. 'link:' symlinks the checkout in
place, so the working-tree manifest is the one that is read and the package keeps using its own
@cloudsforge/contracts-chain is EXACT-PINNED by every consumer of it. This service reads the
EMBER testnet chain id and the confirmation depth from it and defines neither locally: a faucet
with its own copy of 7412 is a faucet that keeps paying out after the estate has moved.
